decision_instrument: operator instruction 'Record the governance closure of RFC-049 Discovery 2 and resolve whether to cancel the now-moot sealed OOS opening instead of spending the single inspection' (received 2026-10-10). The instruction is the authority: docs/governance/RFC049_DISCOVERY_ADMISSION.md section 7 grants the operator 'authorize the campaign, amend governance, promote to paper'.

campaign.terminal_state_basis: DISCOVERY_STOP_RULES.md ST-2: 'no candidate satisfies PROFITABILITY_GATE_V1, including PG-6 and PG-7' -> DISCOVERY_CAMPAIGN_FAILED. Both admitted candidates were closed at the DEV/VAL stage with registered failed criteria, so no candidate can reach the gate.

stop_rules_that_did_not_fire: ST-1 (budget cap: data/rfc049/HYPOTHESIS_REGISTRY.json allows a maximum of 3 admitted hypotheses; 2 were admitted and tested and 0 were refilled, so the cap was not the reason for stopping)

ST-12 (see defects: registered and none invalidates a published measurement)
campaign.subsequent_state: The campaign is over and there is no 'paused and quietly continued' state (DISCOVERY_STOP_RULES.md section 1). Further work on these hypotheses requires a NEW explicit authorization, a new hypothesis budget and a new freeze.

H-049-001.policy: RFC049_DISCOVERY_ADMISSION section 6 — a candidate that fails any stage is closed at that stage

negative_result.substance: both candidates produced a large net result on the 2019-2023 development partition (H-049-001 +39,427 bps / 14 trips, compounded +1035%, LCB +659 bps; H-049-002 +40,176 bps / 26 trips, compounded +1286%, LCB +380 bps) and decayed to non-confirmatory in 2024-2026: raw sums stay positive (+624 / +1,632 bps) while the LCBs are negative (-620 / -294 bps), drawdowns breach the 25% limit (27.9% / 35.2%) and both lose to buy-and-hold (-9,788 / -9,281 bps) and to the 200-day trend baseline (-761 / -254 bps); the ETH replication turns negative in validation for both. Technical validity was never the problem: PIT violations 0, counts reproduced exactly (14/9/23 and 26/22/48), independent verification PASS 37/37 with 8/8 controls and FALSE_SUCCESS 0.

sealed_oos_resolution.gate_as_frozen: data/rfc049/PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json#partition_policy.sealed_oos = 'forward observations strictly after freeze_timestamp_utc; opened once, after 20 closed round trips or 24 months, whichever comes first; fewer than 20 trips at 24 months => INSUFFICIENT_OOS_SAMPLE'; freeze_timestamp_utc = 2026-10-10T11:26:20Z; sealed_oos_start_utc = 2026-10-11T00:00:00Z
why_the_opening_is_moot: Both candidates are closed at the DEV/VAL stage; RFC049_DISCOVERY_ADMISSION section 6 closes a candidate that fails a stage, and a closed candidate cannot be promoted. An OOS reading therefore cannot produce a PASS and cannot change any promotion decision: its decision value is zero.

The gate itself is unreachable inside its own window on this dataset: at the measured turnover H-049-001 expects 5.9 round trips in 24 months (81.0 months to 20) and H-049-002 12.4 (38.8 months to 20), so the mechanical outcome would be INSUFFICIENT_OOS_SAMPLE regardless of the returns.

Opening it anyway would consume the single licensed inspection of uncontaminated forward data for no decision, and ST-8 forbids inspecting OOS more than once per candidate: the information would be spent and unavailable to any later, better-posed hypothesis.
what_this_decision_is_not: not a REJECT on power: the floor of 20 round trips is untouched and the label the gate would have produced remains INSUFFICIENT_OOS_SAMPLE
not an inspection: the sealed window is not read, and OOS_OPENED remains false
not a re-tune, a threshold change, a candidate reopened, or a new budget
not an assertion that the hypotheses were disproved forward: they are closed on their computable criteria, and the forward question stays unanswered

options_considered.option: open the window at the gate anyway and record the forward reading
options_considered.outcome: REJECTED — it would spend the only uncontaminated sample on a candidate that can no longer be promoted, and would create a reading with no decision attached (the unrecorded-trial hazard of ST-10)

options_considered.option: leave the gate armed and let it fire at the 24-month point (2028-10-10)
options_considered.outcome: REJECTED — it would keep two closed candidates alive as tracking objects for 24 months, scheduled to produce a single non-promotable reading; the same irreversible consumption, only later

options_considered.option: retire the opening with the closed candidates (chosen)
options_considered.outcome: the single inspection is voided unused; nothing is read, nothing is spent, and the state stays auditable

sealed_oos_resolution.effect_on_the_frozen_declaration: the frozen declaration in PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json is NOT edited (it is a Phase A record and is hash-protected). This closure record and ADR-0026 are the forward-looking authority and supersede it: the declared opening will not be exercised. No reader may cite the manifest's gate text as evidence that an opening is still pending.
sealed_oos_resolution.effect_on_future_campaigns: a future campaign receives its OWN freeze timestamp and its own sealed window starting strictly after it. It may not claim the 2026-10-11 window as its first inspection: that window was defined for H-049-001/H-049-002 and is retired with them. Nothing prevents a new, separately authorized hypothesis from sealing its own forward window.
sealed_oos_resolution.reversal: only by a new ADR that explicitly reverses ADR-0026. A reversal could re-arm the gate as a data-collection schedule but could not resurrect H-049-001/H-049-002: a terminated candidate is closed, and any restatement of its rules is a new hypothesis with a new id, a new budget and a new freeze.
